name: Anime.js Runtime Adapter
summary: Use Anime.js timelines and registered runtime instances that can be sought deterministically by HyperFrames.
problem: Anime.js animations can drift during preview or rendering when their runtime state is not integrated with HyperFrames seeking.
coreOutcomes: Register Anime.js instances for deterministic seeking
Translate Anime.js patterns into render-safe composition HTML
Keep animation state aligned with the composition timeline
requirements: Anime.js available to the composition runtime
boundaries: Covers Anime.js runtime integration, not overall motion direction
Keep animation time derived from HyperFrames progress rather than a wall clock
